query:
SELECT b.id, b.status, b.startTime, b.endTime, b.lessonType, b.notes,
       DATE_FORMAT(b.bookingDate, '%Y-%m-%d') as date,
       u.name, u.email
FROM bookings b
LEFT JOIN users u ON b.userId = u.id
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(b.bookingDate, '%Y-%m-%d') = '2026-03-18'
ORDER BY b.startTime;
